chunks: Yūnus, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
two men who are found in a single blanket, so he said: “They are to be flogged with the hadd, short by one lash.”

key_terms.سَوْطٍ: a lash or stroke of the whip

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two men are found in one blanket according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding two men found together under one blanket. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that they are to receive a hadd punishment, reduced by one lash.
